description: Program runs but output comparison finds a rounding difference; analysis classifies COMPARE_DIFF and the rounding KB article is retrieved.

input.error_message: Compare mismatch on column NET_AMOUNT: expected 1024.45, actual 1024.44

analyze.root_cause: Rounding difference on decimal output: C# banker's rounding versus COBOL half-up rounding on column NET_AMOUNT.

kb_articles.title: Rounding difference on decimal amount columns: banker's rounding vs COBOL half-up
kb_articles.content: C# decimal rounding uses banker's rounding by default while COBOL uses half-up. This produces a one-cent compare difference on amount columns such as NET_AMOUNT. Apply MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero.

kb_articles.title: NullReference guard clause for absent optional records
kb_articles.content: Add a null guard before field access when an optional COBOL record may be absent in the generated C#.

kb_query: rounding difference decimal NET_AMOUNT banker's rounding compare mismatch half-up
